id: E-5 (a helper whose parent is pid 1 anchors on CLAUDE_PID)
note: Under Git Bash a hook's perl sees getppid() = 1, so the walk to Claude Code started at pid 1, found nothing and took pid 1: every by-pid record (classic-alive.json, sessions, locks) named pid 1. When the walk starts at pid 1 or below, Claude Code's own CLAUDE_PID is now the anchor; without it the helper stays degraded as before. Shown on any host by a helper whose parent exits first, so it is reparented to pid 1. The runner stands in for Claude Code (CLAUDE_PID = the runner's pid, no STORE_TEST_CLAUDE_PID)

setup.text:
#!/bin/sh
# runs the helper with its parent gone: it is reparented to pid 1 before it starts
store=$1; tag=$2
( (sleep 1; exec "$store" hook SessionStart < "$TMP/ss.json" > "$TMP/out-$tag" 2>&1) & echo $! > "$TMP/pid-$tag" )
pid=$(cat "$TMP/pid-$tag")
i=0
while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && [ $i -lt 300 ]; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i+1)); done
cat "$TMP/out-$tag"

steps.name: an orphaned hook with CLAUDE_PID: the records name Claude Code, not pid 1
an orphaned hook without CLAUDE_PID: degraded as before (pid 1)
